audit.whatIsWrong: Full layer gave Graves the first four stages at 7-8/10 and called the lane EVEN at 5.5/10, while the content layer and the packet chart both hand Levels 6 onward to Sejuani. Emerald+ win rate is 40%.
audit.why: Sejuani's scaling is stated in her own kit: Winter's Wrath is percent-max-HP, Frost Armor gives free resists and slow immunity, and Glacial Prison is a 1300-range stun on 120/105/90s. None of that is beaten by True Grit resists.
audit.corrected: Chart set to the packet: Skill / Graves / Graves / Skill / Sejuani / Sejuani / Sejuani, and the lane re-rated HARD 6.5/10 with carry threat 7/10.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer described Level 6 as a Graves spike ('Collateral Damage adds an execute') and never priced Sejuani's level 6 at all.
audit.why: Glacial Prison is 1300 range on 120/105/90s and stuns the first champion hit; Fury of the North then lets her shatter a stunned enemy for massive magic damage. Graves' answer, Quickdraw, is a 425 dash on 16/15/14/13/12s — he cannot dash out of a landed stun.
audit.corrected: Level 6 rewritten as Sejuani's takeover, with the 1300 range and the shatter both stated; first item and 2+ items also flipped to her.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three mechanical errors: (a) Smoke Screen is described as a blind in early and in the jungle section — it has no blind; (b) Permafrost is described as procced by her R on 'enemies near the target' — Permafrost is E, 1.5s cooldown, and fires on a champion at maximum Frost stacks; R's storm merely slows non-primary targets; (c) her R is called a root in wants.foe[2] — it stuns.
audit.why: Riot text, Graves W: 'creates a cloud of smoke that reduces sight range... dealt magic damage and have their Move Speed reduced briefly.' Sejuani E: 'Sejuani freezes and stuns an enemy champion that has maximum Frost stacks.' Sejuani R: 'freezes and stuns the first champion hit and creates an ice storm that slows other enemies.'
audit.corrected: All three corrected in place, and the decisive unmentioned interaction added: Fury of the North grants immunity to slows, so Smoke Screen's slow does nothing to a Sejuani who has been out of combat — the smoke is vision denial only.

audit.whatIsWrong: Arctic Assault was named as the matchup-defining cooldown but never numbered, and its stop-on-first-champion behaviour was absent.
audit.why: Arctic Assault is 650 range, 18/16.5/15/13.5/12s, and 'The charge stops after hitting an enemy champion' — it does not stop on minions, so hiding behind the wave does not deny it.
audit.corrected: Cooldown block and report[5] now carry 650 range and the 12-18s band.

audit.whatIsWrong: Graves' bullets not passing through units was never stated on this page.
audit.why: New Destiny: 'Attacks fire 4 bullets, which cannot pass through units.' Against a melee tank who approaches through the wave, that means a minion body between you absorbs your basic attack outright — the reason to step to an open angle before committing.
audit.corrected: Written into early. Mirrored from the Sejuani-side audit, which added the same fact from her perspective.

edits.before: Sejuani is slow and immobile pre-6, so Levels 2-3 are the only stretch of this lane that isn't tilted against you. Your real window is the moment you hit 2: E in, unload the point-blank 4-shell spread plus the Q cone, and back out on a second E charge before her Winter's Wrath comes online and before her Q dash lands Frost stacks that slow you out of range. Your W blind does little here — she's a percent-HP and CC threat, not an auto-attacker, so blinding her autos barely matters. Side-step her Q (Arctic Assault) dash; if she whiffs it she can't reposition onto you or start her Frost stacking. Trade in bursts and leave — never grind a long fight where her tankiness wins the attrition.
edits.after: Sejuani is slow and immobile pre-6, so Levels 2-3 are the only stretch of this lane that isn't tilted against you. Your real window is the moment you hit 2: E in, unload the point-blank 4-shell spread plus the Q cone, and back out on a second E charge before her Winter's Wrath comes online and before her Q dash lands Frost stacks that slow you out of range. Your W does not blind — it cuts sight range and slows, and Frost Armor makes her immune to slows anyway, so it only denies vision. Your four bullets cannot pass through units, so never shoot through the wave; step to an open angle first. Side-step Arctic Assault (650, 12-18s) and punish the cooldown.

edits.before: This is where it slips. Her Winter's Wrath deals percent-max-HP and scales off the tank HP she's buying, so your True Grit armor/MR stacking does nothing to blunt it — the longer the trade, the worse your math. She out-sustains your shell pokes, and once she lands a Q to stick Frost on you, any all-in you start risks getting Permafrost-stunned before you can E away. At Level 6 her Glacial Prison is a long-range AOE stun (with a Permafrost proc on enemies near the primary target) that locks you on a dime — that's her takeover and your cue to stop dueling. Hold an E charge purely to dodge her Q dash, and only commit when she's burned it.

notes: Both packet suspectNames are FALSE POSITIVES: Winter's Wrath is Sejuani's real W name, and 'Her Frost slows' refers to Frost stacks, not to Permafrost. The real errors were mechanical — Smoke Screen credited with a blind it does not have, Permafrost attributed to her R instead of her E, and her R called a root. The most valuable addition is Frost Armor's slow immunity: Graves' W slow simply does not apply to a Sejuani out of combat, so the smoke is vision denial only. Level chart, diff and difficulty strings were contradictory across layers and are now aligned to the packet chart and the 40% win rate.
